digest.component_or_area: LLM provider qualifier resolution in config layer
propositions: The provider qualifier decision uses a shape regex that asks whether a prefix looks like a provider name rather than whether it is a registered provider name.
A typo'd explicitly configured provider such as 'bedrok' is accepted at config resolution and only fails much later at provider construction.
split_provider_qualifier must decide qualification by membership in a module-level KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES frozenset of 24 pydantic-ai provider names, keeping the colon separator.

An unrecognized inline model prefix must fall back to unqualified without raising, so colon-bearing Bedrock model ids stay intact, while an explicitly configured non-member provider raises LLMConfigError naming it.
Neither 'test' nor 'google_genai' is a member, so infer_provider returns None for those inline prefixes and usage-log provider telemetry changes accordingly.
A drift test guarded by pytest.importorskip asserts runtime registries are a subset of the static KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES set.
